description: Xi'an University of Science and Technology publishes a combined freeway-traffic and accident dataset for the Sacramento area from January through August 2022. Repository metadata lists 59,626,368 records with freeway and station identifiers, travel direction, coordinates, speed, accident indicators and weather variables. ScienceDB provides the main CSV file, a CSV statistics file and a DOCX metadata document. The resource is released free under CC0 1.0. Its size is a count of combined observation records, not a claim that nearly sixty million accidents occurred. This regional dataset has limitations. The time interval and precise joining rules require checking the metadata before calibration. It can support traffic-flow scenarios, incident detection and disruption studies. No directly related catalogue entry was identified; a separate connected road network is needed for assignment or rerouting simulations.
